name: feature-pipeline
description: Cached setup -> scoped analysis -> quick-spec for decision-free changes of at most two files, otherwise requirements/design/plan -> implement -> parallel independent reviews and validation -> deterministic gated completion.

args.fastPath: boolean, default true; quick-spec only for <=2 scoped files with no needs_user or pending decisions
args.earlyValidate: boolean, default true; run validate beside reviewers, discard on rejection
args.useAggregator: boolean, default false; optional aggregate agent cannot overrule deterministic safety gates
args.stepTimeoutMs: positive integer or role/label map; defaults in minutes: setup 3, analysis 6, quick-spec/requirements/plan 5, design/designReview 6, implementer 20, reviewer 10, validate 8; private routing marker carries timeoutMs
args.cachedSetup: internal validated setup object: stack string, testCommands/lintCommands/conventions string arrays

whenToUse: A non-trivial feature or change in a repository that benefits from separate design, implementation, independent multi-model review and final validation.

phases.title: setup
phases.detail: Inspect repo: stack, test/lint commands, conventions

phases.title: analysis
phases.detail: Inspect only the requested change scope and produce a current-state decision brief

phases.title: requirements
phases.detail: Turn the request into testable acceptance criteria

phases.title: design-loop
phases.detail: Draft design, review, repeat until APPROVED (max N)

phases.title: plan
phases.detail: Ordered implementation plan with file scope and verify commands

phases.title: code-loop
phases.detail: Implement, parallel independent reviews, aggregate verdict, repeat until APPROVED (max N)

phases.title: validate
phases.detail: Check the final result against the original requirements
